opts.title: Settings
opts.sub: Where the steering wheel is, easy exit, and how the Seats app works

opts.label: Steering wheel on the
opts.sub: Right: the driver's seat in the right half

opts.label: Easy exit
opts.sub: Door open: out of the way · door shut: back

opts.text: The seats move while you drive too, as with their own switches (which always win); Make room only while parked.
Hold a control: the seat moves while you hold it and stops when you let go.
M1 - M3 are this app's own memories, three per seat: tap Save, then M1, M2 or M3 to keep the seat as it is.
Make room moves the passenger seat out of the way; Move back puts it where it was.
While a seat moves to a memory or makes room, tap its lit button or any control to stop it.
Easy exit, each seat: Save, then Easy exit. Door open, car standing: out of the way; shut: back (driver: car on, passenger: seated).

opts.head: Comfort tool not installed
opts.line: Install the Comfort tool from the Store
